Q: Google Routes API : Specifying what routes I want in Compute Route Matrix A:

The Route Matrix provides a Route Matrix (from all to all), as the name implies.

The best way to get the 50 routes would be to have them individually queried as you suggested. Based on your description of "being too slow", I am expecting you are considering getting each route sequentially, waiting for the response. This is no needed - since they are fully independent, they should be able to be queried in parallel which would eliminate the "being too slow" problem.
